title: merge --lane-lint names which same-session PR a head clashes with, and the fold build tests it before the lint
why: Coordinator 23:05 CST Nov 13, corrected 23:07 (relayed; unchecked by triage): merge --lane-lint refuses a head that conflicts with another open PR of the same session (merge-tree), with no override, and does not say which. The gate's scope is the same-session PRs, not all open PRs: decision lanes-run-no-full-ci-job, "The cross rule"; merge/merge.py cross_measure (~line 2494) picks open PRs whose body has the same session URL as the target, plus --with. An integration PR gets a report line, no refusal.
source: Coordinator messages 23:05 and 23:07 CST Nov 13 (relayed); home for the words: lane merge-tool-audit-fixes read, 23:06. Related: steps release-pairwise-clash (todo), merge-tree-check-tool (queued).
note: Triage 23:08 CST Nov 13: two parts. (1) The lint output names the same-session PR whose head clashes, so a lane can fix it earlier. (2) The batch runner's fold build clash-tests each member against the same-session open PRs before the lint. The step may already be met: check is_integration_pr in merge/merge.py first (lane merge-tool-audit-fixes reads it now); if met, close this step and say so. Also check release-pairwise-clash and merge-tree-check-tool. Not started. Coordinator 23:07 CST (relayed; lane merge-tool-audit-fixes read, unchecked by triage): is_integration_pr (merge/merge.py ~4192) needs a batch-freeze block in the body AND branch = integration_branch(name). Neither #3360 nor #3356 has one, so the cross rule treats them as lane PRs and refuses same-session clashes. Smallest fix: a combined-PR marker line in the body, read only for cross_measure's integration argument; it changes decision lanes-run-no-full-ci-job and must name ruling own-767-a-combined-pr (whose text says only the wording changes, "not the tool"). That needs the owner: page item 811 pick-combined-pr-marker, posted 23:09 CST Nov 13. Workaround meanwhile: combined PRs name distinct sessions; runner 10 closes #2857. Blocked on item 811.
